scope: Initial official evidence intake for the Huarmey-Culebras discovery corridor. Rio Huarmey and Rio Culebras remain separate hydrologic components. This package supports research prioritization and historical reconstruction only.

sources.institution: Municipalidad Provincial de Huarmey / MVCS coordination

el_nino_2017.evidence: The official Huarmey risk evaluation characterizes 2017 rainfall in Huarmey and the middle western-slope basin as extremely rainy and reports local frequency/intensity exceeding the 1982-83 and 1997-98 El Nino episodes.

next_normalization_steps: obtain and normalize official Rio Huarmey and Rio Culebras hydrologic-unit geometries independently
extract dated 2017 outcomes and reconstruct 1982-83 and 1997-98 local evidence without assuming undocumented equivalence
identify event-paired SENAMHI/ANA rainfall and river observations
map urban, agricultural, bridge, Panamericana and water-intake exposure by component
retain 2026 protection works as current mitigation context only
scientific_limits: No event-day rainfall, stage or discharge time series is normalized in this asset.
Critical-point counts are prevention context, not historical event counts.
Current ANIN/municipal works are not backcast as historical hydraulic capacity.
No negative control is inferred from an unreported day.
No design value or provider alert becomes an IRFEN threshold.
